title: Walter Wright
clean_html:
Walter Wright

Preserved Primary Document • wrightw2.htm

Walter B. Wright was born in Sussex Co., DE on 21 January 1881. He died there on 1 March 1983. He married Anna C. Davis, daughter of John Davis and Mary Elizabeth Jackson and they had the following children: Gertrude Wright who married Noah Harmon, Jr. the son of Noah Harmon. They had the following children: Gloria Harmon who married Glenn Barrentine Walter Wright Clarence Wright Douglas Wright Curtis Wright Valerie Wright
